items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: There was Cheap, Laura's husband... That was in my husband's time. I'm trying to call them young boys in the band.

ctx.x: You don't know what Kenchon played?

No, I don't know what, I can't remember. But I do remember the first parade they played was on the, in May. It was, was it the Odd Colors parade? They used to parade. And that day, that morning they had the eclipse of the sun and everything went dark. I remember that. Because we was living then on 7th street between Ramport and Drives. 1912. And Uncle brought that little, and Kenchon brought that band out to all those boys. There was my husband. There was Cheap, Laura's husband. What's his last name? Cheap, one…
